description.en: Everyday colloquial fillers, colorful banter, expressive gestures, and common expletives.
description.zh-CN: 意式日常口头禅、接地气的俚语感叹、生动彩色粗口及哥们儿间的玩笑吐槽。

translations.en: I don't know! / Beats me! / No clue!
translations.zh-CN: 不知道！ / 谁知道呢！ / 毫无头绪！

pronunciationNotes.en: The quintessential Italian filler word. Shrug your shoulders and puff your lower lip.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 全意大利最万能的口头语气词，通常伴随耸肩、摊手和下唇微噘。

exampleSentence.it: A che ora arriva il treno? — Boh, sarà in ritardo come al solito.
exampleSentence.en: What time does the train arrive? — Beats me, it'll probably be late as usual.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 火车几点到？——谁知道呢，估计照例晚点。

translations.en: Come on! / Hurry up! / Stop joking!
translations.zh-CN: 快点！ / 得了吧！ / 别闹了！

pronunciationNotes.en: Multi-purpose exclamation: encouragement ('Dai, puoi farcela!'), disbelief ('Ma dai, sul serio?!'), or urging.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 超级多功能词：可表示催促快点、鼓励加油、或表示难以置信'得了吧！'。

exampleSentence.it: Dai, sbrigati che perdiamo l'autobus!
exampleSentence.en: Come on, hurry up or we'll miss the bus!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 快点，赶紧的，不然要赶不上公交了！

translations.en: Damn! / Heck! / Crap! (mild expletive)
translations.zh-CN: 可恶！ / 糟糕！ / 天哪！ (温和脏话)

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally means 'cabbage'. Family-friendly substitute for 'cazzo'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思是'卷心菜'，作为温和避讳词代替粗鲁的cazzo，公共场合也可用。

exampleSentence.it: Cavolo, ho dimenticato il portafoglio a casa!
exampleSentence.en: Damn, I forgot my wallet at home!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 糟糕，我把钱包忘在家里了！

translations.en: How cool! / What an awesome thing!
translations.zh-CN: 太帅了！ / 太酷了！ / 太绝了！

pronunciationNotes.en: Youth slang meaning very cool, stylish, or impressive.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意国年轻人极高频流行语，形容非常酷炫、爽快、令人赞叹的事物。

exampleSentence.it: Hai preso i biglietti per il concerto? Che figata!
exampleSentence.en: You got the concert tickets? How cool!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你买到演唱会门票了？太酷了吧！

translations.en: What a pain! / What a drag! / How boring!
translations.zh-CN: 真烦人！ / 烦死了！ / 真是个大麻烦！

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally 'what balls'. Widely used to express intense annoyance or boredom.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思'什么球啊'，日常宣泄极其厌烦、心烦气躁情绪的最常用俚语。

exampleSentence.it: Piove ancora e non possiamo uscire, che palle!
exampleSentence.en: It's raining again and we can't go out, what a pain!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 又下雨了没法出门，烦死了！

translations.en: Fuck! / Shit! / Damn! (vulgar expletive)
translations.zh-CN: 卧槽！ / 该死！ / 他妈的！ (核心粗话)

pronunciationNotes.en: The most versatile profanity in Italian. Used for anger, shock, emphasis, or pain.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意语中使用最广泛的国骂级感叹词，宣泄愤怒、震惊或极度强调。注意场合！

exampleSentence.it: Cazzo, mi sono fatto male al dito!
exampleSentence.en: Fuck, I hurt my finger!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 卧槽，我手指砸伤了！

translations.en: A huge mess / A ton of / Chaos
translations.zh-CN: 大乱子 / 乱七八糟 / 一大堆 / 巨多

pronunciationNotes.en: Originally meant brothel; now means chaos or huge quantity ('Mi manchi un casino').
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 现意为极其混乱或数量巨大。如'Fa un casino di rumore'(吵得要死)。

exampleSentence.it: C'era un casino di traffico in tangenziale stamattina.
exampleSentence.en: There was crazy traffic on the ring road this morning.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今天早上环线上堵得一塌糊涂。

translations.en: Thank goodness! / What a relief!
translations.zh-CN: 幸好！ / 谢天谢地！ / 太万幸了！

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally 'less bad'. Uttered with a sigh of relief.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思'少受点坏影响'，如释重负时必说的感叹。

exampleSentence.it: Non hai perso il treno? Meno male!
exampleSentence.en: You didn't miss the train? Thank goodness!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你没错过火车？太万幸了！

translations.en: Don't mention it! / No big deal! / Imagine that!
translations.zh-CN: 客气啥！ / 小事一桩！ / 别见外！

pronunciationNotes.en: Very warm colloquial response to thanks or apologies. Formal is 'Si figuri!'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 亲切随和的应答语，回复他人感谢或道歉：'哪里的事，客气啥！'。

exampleSentence.it: — Grazie mille dell'aiuto! — Figurati, è stato un piacere!
exampleSentence.en: — Thanks a lot for the help! — Don't mention it, it was a pleasure!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: ——非常感谢你的帮助！——客气啥，乐意效劳！

translations.en: I wish! / If only! / Would that it were so!
translations.zh-CN: 要是能那样就好了！ / 但愿如此！ / 想得美！

pronunciationNotes.en: Deeply expressive Mediterranean sentiment longing for an idealized outcome.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 地中海文化特有的愿景感叹词，表达强烈而美好的期盼。

exampleSentence.it: Hai vinto alla lotteria? — Magari!
exampleSentence.en: Did you win the lottery? — I wish!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你中彩票了？——要是真中就好了！

translations.en: Asshole / Jerk / Bastard (insult)
translations.zh-CN: 混蛋 / 狗杂种 / 讨厌鬼 (常见骂人词)

pronunciationNotes.en: One of the most widespread insults in Italian. Feminine is 'stronza'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意语最常见、杀伤力强的辱骂词之一，指自私卑劣之人，女性用stronza。

exampleSentence.it: Quel tipo mi ha tagliato la strada, che stronzo!
exampleSentence.en: That guy cut me off in traffic, what an asshole!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 那家伙别我车，真是一个混蛋！

translations.en: Fuck off! / Go to hell! (strong curse)
translations.zh-CN: 滚蛋！ / 去你的！ / 滚犊子！ (经典粗口)

pronunciationNotes.en: Contracted from 'va a fare in culo'. Iconic Italian dismissal.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利最臭名昭著的经典脏话，火气极大时的驱赶斥责语。千万谨慎使用！

exampleSentence.it: Ma lasciami in pace e vaffanculo!
exampleSentence.en: Just leave me alone and fuck off!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 别烦我，滚一边去！

translations.en: My goodness! / Oh my god! / Wow!
translations.zh-CN: 我的妈呀！ / 天哪！ / 哎呀！

pronunciationNotes.en: Authentic exclamation for shock, joy, exasperation, or sheer disbelief.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利人的文化符号名片，表达震惊、绝望、狂喜或惊叹。

exampleSentence.it: Mamma mia, che bontà questa pizza!
exampleSentence.en: Oh my goodness, how delicious is this pizza!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我的天，这披萨也太好吃了！

translations.en: How disgusting! / That's gross!
translations.zh-CN: 太恶心了！ / 太难吃了！ / 恶心死了！

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ch' is hard /k/. Expresses intense disgust with food, dirt, or behavior.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'chi'发ki音，强烈表达对食物难吃、环境肮脏或卑劣行为的厌恶反感。

exampleSentence.it: C'è un capello nella minestra, che schifo!
exampleSentence.en: There's a hair in the soup, how disgusting!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 汤里有一根头发，恶心死了！

translations.en: Do you feel like it? / Are you up for it?
translations.zh-CN: 你想去吗？ / 你意下如何？ / 去不去？

pronunciationNotes.en: Everyday informal suggestion: 'Ti va di uscire?' (Feel like going out?).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 朋友间发出提议最地道的方式：'Ti va un gelato?'(想不想吃冰淇淋？)。

exampleSentence.it: Ti va di andare al cinema stasera?
exampleSentence.en: Do you feel like going to the movies tonight?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今晚你想去看电影吗？

translations.en: Relax! / Don't worry! / Chill! / Take it easy!
translations.zh-CN: 放轻松！ / 别慌！ / 没事儿！

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'll' is held. Used to soothe someone stressed or panicking.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 常用来安抚焦虑或感到抱歉的朋友，女孩子说'Tranquilla!'。

exampleSentence.it: Tranquillo, abbiamo tutto il tempo di arrivare.
exampleSentence.en: Relax, we have plenty of time to get there.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 别慌，我们有充裕的时间赶到。

translations.en: It works / That makes sense / I'm down / Sounds good
translations.zh-CN: 没毛病 / 可以有 / 挺合理的 / 我赞成

pronunciationNotes.en: Very trendy colloquial assent: 'Un drink adesso? — Sì, ci sta!'
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 当下年轻人极度高频的认同短语，表示'合情合理、可以接受、我同意'。

exampleSentence.it: Una birra fresca dopo questa camminata ci sta proprio!
exampleSentence.en: A cold beer after this walk really hits the spot!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 走完这趟路来杯冰啤酒，真是太到位了！

translations.en: To make a bad impression / To look bad / Lose face
translations.zh-CN: 丢人现眼 / 丢脸 / 留坏印象 / 失礼

pronunciationNotes.en: Cornerstone concept of Italian social etiquette: avoiding public embarrassment.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利社交文化核心禁忌，强调维持体面，极力避免当众出丑丢面子。

exampleSentence.it: Vestiti bene, non vogliamo fare brutta figura al matrimonio.
exampleSentence.en: Dress well, we don't want to make a bad impression at the wedding.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 穿得体面点，我们可不想在婚礼上丢人现眼。

translations.en: To make a great impression / Look sharp / Shine
translations.zh-CN: 给人留下好印象 / 讲究体面 / 出彩

pronunciationNotes.en: The opposite of 'brutta figura' — presenting yourself impeccably.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 与丢脸相反，指做事体面、穿着光鲜、给人留下极佳深刻印象。

exampleSentence.it: Portiamo una bottiglia di buon vino per fare bella figura.
exampleSentence.en: Let's bring a bottle of good wine to make a great impression.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们带瓶好酒去，这样显得体面大方。

translations.en: I don't feel like it / I don't want to
translations.zh-CN: 我不想去 / 我没心情 / 我不想干

pronunciationNotes.en: Direct colloquial refusal of an invitation or proposal.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 口语直接拒绝提议：'Non mi va di studiare stasera'(今晚我不想学)。

exampleSentence.it: Grazie dell'invito, ma stasera non mi va di uscire.
exampleSentence.en: Thanks for the invite, but tonight I don't feel like going out.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 谢谢邀请，但我今晚真没心情出门。

translations.en: What chaos! / What an insane mess!
translations.zh-CN: 太混乱了！ / 乱成一锅粥！ / 闹翻天了！

pronunciationNotes.en: Synonym with 'casino', refers to a noisy, unruly, chaotic situation.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 形容喧闹嘈杂、极度混乱无序的场面，粗俗但极常听见。

exampleSentence.it: C'era un bordello incredibile allo stadio ieri sera.
exampleSentence.en: There was incredible chaos at the stadium last night.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 昨晚球场里简直乱成了一锅粥。

translations.en: To bump into / To catch / To hook up with
translations.zh-CN: 撞见 / 碰上 / 逮住 (俚语)

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'cc' is hard /kk/. 'Ci becchiamo dopo' = Let's catch up later.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 年轻人极常用动词：'Ci becchiamo dopo'(我们回头碰头见)。

exampleSentence.it: Ho beccato Marco al bar mentre prendeva il caffè.
exampleSentence.en: I bumped into Marco at the bar while he was having coffee.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我在咖啡吧正好撞见了在喝咖啡的马可。

translations.en: See you later, guys!
translations.zh-CN: 待会儿见，兄弟们 / 朋友们！

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Raga' is the universal Italian youth slang abbreviation for 'ragazzi' (guys/folks).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'raga'是ragazzi的简写口头语，相当于英文的'guys'或中文的'兄弟们/大家'。

exampleSentence.it: Io devo andare a lezione, ci vediamo dopo, raga!
exampleSentence.en: I have to go to class, see you later guys!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我得上课去了，待会儿见兄弟们！

translations.en: No way! / Not at all! / As if!
translations.zh-CN: 哪有的事！ / 怎么可能！ / 才不是呢！

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'cch' is strong /kk/. Used to vigorously deny or brush off something.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 强烈否认或反驳对方假定时使用，发音短促有力。

exampleSentence.it: Hai finito tutto il lavoro? — Macché, sono ancora a metà!
exampleSentence.en: Did you finish all the work? — No way, I'm still halfway through!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你工作都做完了？——哪有的事，刚做了一半！

translations.en: Really?! / You don't say?! / Seriously?!
translations.zh-CN: 真的假的？！ / 怎么会？！ / 别扯了？！

pronunciationNotes.en: Tone determines whether it means genuine disbelief or sarcastic obviousness.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 根据语调既可表示难以置信的惊讶，也可反讽'这还用你说？'。

exampleSentence.it: Ha lasciato il lavoro a tempo indeterminato?! — Ma va?!
exampleSentence.en: He quit his permanent job?! — You don't say?!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 他把铁饭碗工作辞了？！——真的假的？！

translations.en: You're the best! / You rock! / You legend!
translations.zh-CN: 你太强了！ / 太给力了！ / 你是真大佬！

pronunciationNotes.en: Ultimate informal compliment to a friend who helped you out.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意式哥们儿之间极高褒奖，朋友帮了大忙时脱口而出。

exampleSentence.it: Grazie per avermi riparato la macchina, sei un grande!
exampleSentence.en: Thanks for fixing my car, you're the best!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 谢谢帮我修好车，你太给力了兄弟！

translations.en: What an embarrassing shitshow! / What an utter disgrace!
translations.zh-CN: 太丢人现眼了！ / 颜面扫地！ / 丢死人了！

pronunciationNotes.en: The vulgar, amplified version of 'brutta figura'. Uttered in extreme embarrassment.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: brutta figura的强力脏话升级版，形容当众遭遇极度尴尬耻辱的场面。

exampleSentence.it: Mi sono dimenticato il nome del capo davanti a tutti, che figura di merda!
exampleSentence.en: I forgot the boss's name in front of everyone, what an embarrassing disgrace!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我当着全公司面把老板名字忘了，太丢人了！

translations.en: It sucks! / It's absolute crap! (vulgar)
translations.zh-CN: 太烂了！ / 难吃/难看死了！ / 极其恶劣！

pronunciationNotes.en: Crude expression of intense distaste towards food, movies, or art.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 粗鲁直白地表达某样东西极度难看、难吃或粗制滥造。

exampleSentence.it: Quel film d'azione mi fa cagare, non guardarlo.
exampleSentence.en: That action movie sucks balls, don't watch it.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 那部动作片拍得跟屎一样烂，别看了。

translations.en: To bust someone's balls / To annoy / To pester
translations.zh-CN: 烦人 / 惹人讨厌 / 讨嫌 / 找茬

pronunciationNotes.en: Politer version of 'rompere i coglioni' (to bust balls).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 委婉表达别人烦扰捣乱的短语，比rompere i coglioni文明。

exampleSentence.it: Smettila di rompermi le scatole mentre studio!
exampleSentence.en: Stop busting my balls while I'm studying!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我学习呢，别在这儿烦我！

translations.en: Haphazardly / Half-assed / Shoddily done
translations.zh-CN: 敷衍了事 / 粗制滥造 / 乱七八糟地胡搞

pronunciationNotes.en: Famous Italian idiomatic curse meaning something done with zero care or method.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 极为传神生动的意式粗鄙俚语，形容做事毫无条理、敷衍草率至极。

exampleSentence.it: Questo lavoro è stato fatto proprio a cazzo di cane.
exampleSentence.en: This job was done completely half-assed.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 这活儿干得真是毫无章法、敷衍了事。

translations.en: Bullshit / Nonsense / Dumb mistake
translations.zh-CN: 胡扯 / 鬼话 / 蠢事 / 脑残行为

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'zz' is /tts/. 'Non dire cazzate!' = Don't talk bullshit!
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 指荒谬言论或愚蠢犯错，'Non dire cazzate'表示别扯淡胡说。

exampleSentence.it: Non credere a quello che dice, sono tutte cazzate.
exampleSentence.en: Don't believe what he says, it's all bullshit.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 别信他说的话，全都是胡说八道。

translations.en: I couldn't care less / I don't give a damn
translations.zh-CN: 我根本不在乎 / 关我屁事 / 关我啥事

pronunciationNotes.en: Colloquial verb 'fregarsene'. Very common expression of total indifference.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 极高频日常俚语，表示彻底冷漠无感或不屑一顾。

exampleSentence.it: Cosa ne pensa la gente? Non me ne frega niente!
exampleSentence.en: What do people think? I don't give a damn!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 别人怎么看？关我屁事！

translations.en: Dickhead / Jerk / Total idiot (insult)
translations.zh-CN: 脑残 / 蠢蛋 / 王八蛋 (典型辱骂语)

pronunciationNotes.en: Very offensive direct insult to someone's intelligence or behavior.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 极度尖锐的辱骂用语，骂人行为卑鄙不可理喻。

exampleSentence.it: Quel testa di cazzo non rispetta le regole del condominio.
exampleSentence.en: That dickhead doesn't respect the building rules.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 那个王八蛋从来不遵守公寓规矩。

translations.en: Holy shit! / Damn! / Whoa! (Sicilian exclamation)
translations.zh-CN: 哇塞！ / 卧槽！ / 妈呀！ (经典西西里感叹词)

pronunciationNotes.en: Originally Sicilian, now universally understood across Italy for surprise.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 原为西西里俚语，现已风靡全意大利，表达极大震惊或惊叹。

exampleSentence.it: Minchia, quanto costa quella macchina sportiva?!
exampleSentence.en: Holy shit, how much does that sports car cost?!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 卧槽，那辆跑车要多少钱啊？！

translations.en: It's a blast! / Fantastic! / The bomb!
translations.zh-CN: 太炸裂了！ / 太给力了！ / 绝绝子！

pronunciationNotes.en: Slang for something exceptionally exciting, flavorful, or powerful.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 形容某事物极度震撼、美味或精彩绝伦，炸裂般的好。

exampleSentence.it: Questo panino con la porchetta è una bomba!
exampleSentence.en: This roast pork sandwich is the bomb!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 这个意式烤猪肉帕尼尼简直绝了，太炸裂了！

translations.en: To go smoothly / Without a hitch
translations.zh-CN: 进展顺利 / 顺顺当当 / 一帆风顺

pronunciationNotes.en: 'sc' before 'i' makes /ʃ/ (like 'sh'). 'È andato tutto liscio' = All went smoothly.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'sci'发拼音sh音，字面'走得平滑'，表示事情顺当顺利。

exampleSentence.it: Come è andato l'esame? — Tutto liscio come l'olio!
exampleSentence.en: How did the exam go? — Smooth as butter!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 考试考得怎么样？——像油一样顺，顺顺当当！

translations.en: Come on, you got this! / You can do it!
translations.zh-CN: 加油，你一定可以的！ / 挺住，你能行！

pronunciationNotes.en: Phrasal verb 'farcela' (to manage/succeed). Very encouraging.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 使用代词动词farcela，意大利朋友间最热血的加油打气句。

exampleSentence.it: Manca solo un chilometro al traguardo, dai che ce la fai!
exampleSentence.en: Only one kilometer to the finish line, come on, you got this!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 离终点就剩最后一公里了，加油你能行的！

translations.en: To rock / To kill it / To nail it
translations.zh-CN: 超神 / 炸场 / 搞定一切 / 帅炸了

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally 'to smash/break'. Double 'cc' is /kk/. 'Hai spaccato!' = You killed it!
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面为打碎，俚语意为'帅爆了/超常发挥/征服全场'。

exampleSentence.it: La tua band ieri sera ha spaccato di brutto!
exampleSentence.en: Your band totally rocked the stage last night!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你们乐队昨晚的演出简直帅炸了！

translations.en: To be damn lucky / Pure luck (slang)
translations.zh-CN: 走狗屎运 / 运气爆棚 (俚语)

pronunciationNotes.en: Colloquial expression equating luck with good fortune: 'Che culo!' = What luck!
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意式俚语用culo表示运气，'Che culo!'表示'太走运了/真是狗屎运！'。

exampleSentence.it: Hai trovato parcheggio proprio lì? Che culo!
exampleSentence.en: You found a parking spot right there? What luck!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你在那儿居然找到了停车位？真走狗屎运！

translations.en: Of course! / Don't mention it! / It goes without saying!
translations.zh-CN: 那当然！ / 哪里的话！ / 义不容辞！

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ch' is hard /k/. Conditional of 'mancare'. Warm reassurance.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 极其优雅又亲切的意大利式应答，意为'那还用说，必须的！'。

exampleSentence.it: — Posso farti una domanda? — Ci mancherebbe altro, dimmi pure!
exampleSentence.en: — May I ask you a question? — Of course, please go ahead!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: ——能问你个问题吗？——哪里的话，随时问！
